name: Megiddo

related_people.name: Josiah

related_people.name: Pharaoh Neco
related_people.role: Egypt's king, who killed King Josiah in battle here

description: A strategic fortress city controlling the Jezreel Valley where King Josiah was fatally wounded confronting Pharaoh Neco's army (2 Kings 23:29-30), and the source of the name "Armageddon" (Har Megiddo) in Revelation 16:16.
family_friendly_summary: Megiddo was a fortress city that guarded an important valley. Good King Josiah was fatally wounded there in a battle against Egypt's army. The name "Armageddon" in the book of Revelation comes from "Har Megiddo," meaning the hill of Megiddo.
